session_state.player_state: Session 1 ended immediately after the party defeated the giant rats in Area 1.
session_state.freeze_rule: Do not spend further polish time on completed content unless a defect blocks continuity or later backtracking.

source_basis.source_priority: Private adventure source remains canonical for authored facts. Any scaling or presentation changes for the 2-PC party must be recorded separately as deliberate playability adaptations.

source_grounded: Intact rectangular ritual chamber with buttresses/columns.
Four 10-foot-deep floor-set pools: blue, green, clear, cloudy.
Wall carvings depict robed figures submerging in the pools.
Large ornate double door at the far end; room mechanics remain hidden.
build_focus: ornate double door and lock presentation

source_grounded: Passage widens for roughly ninety feet, then narrows to an ornate double door.
Four distinct trap zones protect the room.
Beyond the door is a stone chamber with wall slabs holding cloth-wrapped bodies.
Four zombies rise; creatures affected by the door can appear wrapped and temporarily paralyzed.
Treasure includes a potion of healing and a spell scroll of bless.
build_focus: trap-zone geometry without player-visible debug cues
mummy chamber slabs and wrapped bodies

source_grounded: Off-map maze of crisscrossing/collapsed passages and earthquake-weakened sections.
Navigation follows Teeshe and Boot's trail.
A cave-in must be cleared.
A circular passage is overgrown with blood weeds.
The final maze passage contains an obligatory weak-acid pit with floating bones.
build_focus: represent as a compact navigable montage rather than literal huge maze

source_grounded: Natural cavern with ceiling obscured by thick dusty webs.
Five web cocoons hang down, including one larger suspicious humanoid-shaped cocoon.
A giant spider hides in a floor depression.
Constable Yander Boot's corpse hangs suspended in webs.
Natural cavern with stalactites/stalagmites.
Gorkoh the goblin hides behind a stalagmite and bluffs with driftwood as a magic wand.
A wounded carrion crawler waits in the next section.
A fragile stalactite cluster can be dropped onto the crawler.
Bones/gear and a +1 longsword are visible treasure.
Room contains hundreds of rotting severed humanoid feet with no blood.
Ten feet are stomping-foot creatures.
A suspended granite 'Big Foot' hazard attacks from above.
Rune-carved footprints on north and south walls power/deactivate the hazard.
build_focus: macabre foot clutter without excessive visual noise

source_grounded: Round sewer room with pipes in the ceiling feeding a central cesspool.
Outer ten feet of pool is 3 feet deep; inner area is 10 feet deep.
A ten-foot-wide walkway skirts the pool to a passage opposite.
An enormous extraplanar tentacle reaches through a weak planar barrier.
Brass dragon wyrmling Dabshabah is trapped beneath earthquake rubble.
Two darkmantles are waiting out the dragon and attack the party when engaged.
Teeshe and a large armored female human passed east through here earlier.
Dead dwarf Caerhan Coalsmith, Sergeant Teeshe, altar, and damaged Orrey housing are present.
Teeshe is possessed by a spirit loyal to That-Which-Endures and attacks if the shrine is disturbed.
An entropy guardian above the altar animates and attacks throughout the room.
The granite altar is covered in runes.
The magical destruction here caused the earthquake; the Orrey housing is the key campaign artifact.
Captain Truff meets the party after they climb out and inventories recovered goods.
A Xanathar Guild thug named Stork leads three bandits in an ambush for the recovered treasure.
Captain Truff fights alongside the party; rescued Gorkoh/Teeshe and Otis may also assist.
Episode concludes with the party returning to Acquisitions Incorporated, reaching 2nd level, receiving payment if successful, and being sent toward Phandalin.

next_session_readiness.reason: These are the most probable contents for the next 3-hour session from the current stopping point; later areas still receive structural prep but are second-pass polish.
next_session_readiness.party_specific_note: Encounter/trap difficulty for two 1st-level PCs must be reviewed explicitly before release. Do not silently change source mechanics.

immediate_use: Material Browser and Effects for faster room dressing where results still resolve to ordinary 3D Canvas scene content.
Dungeons & Interiors as a layout accelerator for Areas 3-10 when it produces geometry consistent with the semantic model.
later_use: Cutscene Panel for episode openings, reveals, Area 8 tentacle emergence, Area 9 dragon reveal, Area 10 shrine/Orrey reveal, and episode transition.
